end.summary: Practised the levels of organisation: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the sequence using a bricks-to-wall analogy and discussed how cells work together in tissues and organs. Yash explained that tissues are groups of cells and that Amoeba is a single cell carrying out life processes on its own. The mix-up between an organ and an organ system was not corrected by the end; at home, revise the sequence with one example at each level.
